Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a truck driver and a professor had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the truck driver and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of cocaine. After the professor's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who had drugs on them?
A. The truck driver
B. Not known
C. The professor
